title: install.sh never cd's to its own directory and blames the internet for the result
method: ran install.sh from a directory other than the repository root
observed_at_discovery: Run from an empty temp directory, install.sh created a stray .venv there, then exited 1. pip's raw "ERROR: Could not open requirements file: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'requirements-core.txt'" printed to the screen -- the failing pip call has no 2>/dev/null, unlike the succeeding one -- followed by "Couldn't download Cura's parts. This is almost always the internet connection rather than anything you did." Re-running from the same directory repeats it verbatim forever ('Cura's space already exists -- reusing it'), and nothing printed points at the real cause. README.md never states where to run it from.
